claim: Bulk export steps: Get Started under Download your account.

quote: On the next page, select "Request download."

claim: Strava emails a link; may take a few hours.
quote: You will receive an email with a link to download your data (this may take a few hours).

claim: Exporting is only available on the website.
quote: Please note that exporting your data is only available on the Strava website.
As of May 25th, 2018, Strava provides the option to export an archive of your account.
In many cases, the original will be in FIT (Flexible and Interoperable Data Transfer) format.
TCX export only works for activities with GPS data, which may exclude indoor activities with no GPS.

claim: TCX carries heart rate, cadence and watts.
quote: TCX files contain more information than GPX files, such as heart rate, cadence, and watts.

claim: GPX without GPS is unreadable or empty.
quote: any activity that does not contain GPS data will produce an unreadable or empty file

claim: GPX includes power-meter power, not estimated power.
quote: GPX files exported from Strava will contain power data recorded with a power meter but not estimated power.

claim: New apps start in single-player mode.
quote: All new applications start in single-player mode.

claim: Single-player: only your own account can authenticate.
quote: only your own Strava account can authenticate with the app
A Strava subscription is a prerequisite for creating an app.
